target_roles.title: VP of Product Management
target_roles.rationale: MUTOH is actively launching new products (HydrAton printer in 2025, new eco-solvent printers at PRINTING United 2024) and has won four Pinnacle Product Awards in 2024, indicating strong focus on product innovation and differentiation. The VP of Product Management would be responsible for complete solutions portfolios and ecosystem partnerships. Tedlar represents a premium differentiation opportunity: MUTOH could recommend or bundle Tedlar overlaminates with their wide-format printers for vehicle wraps, outdoor signage, and durable graphics applications. This creates a competitive advantage by offering customers a complete durability solution (printer + ink + protective film) that extends graphics lifespan to 12-20+ years, reduces warranty claims on printed output, and positions MUTOH as the premium choice for outdoor applications. This role cares about product portfolio strategy, competitive positioning, customer success metrics, and recurring revenue opportunities through consumables/accessories ecosystems.

target_roles.title: Director of Business Development
target_roles.rationale: MUTOH's customers are sign manufacturers, vehicle wrap installers, and graphics producers—precisely Tedlar's target end users. The Director of Business Development would manage channel partnerships, distributor relationships, and strategic alliances. Partnering with DuPont Tedlar enables MUTOH to provide added value to their customer base by recommending a proven protective overlaminate that solves common pain points: UV degradation, graffiti damage on vehicle wraps, premature fading on outdoor signage, and high replacement costs. This partnership would strengthen MUTOH's customer relationships, increase stickiness with installers who need complete solutions, and create cross-selling opportunities at trade shows like PRINTING United and SEMA where both companies exhibit. This role owns revenue growth, partnership ROI, customer retention, and market expansion—all directly enhanced by offering Tedlar as part of MUTOH's solution ecosystem.

target_roles.title: Director of Marketing
target_roles.rationale: MUTOH has been honored by PRINTING United Alliance for 13 consecutive years and actively exhibits at major industry trade shows (PRINTING United Expo 2025, SEMA 2025), demonstrating sophisticated marketing execution and industry leadership positioning. The Director of Marketing would be responsible for brand positioning, competitive differentiation messaging, and customer education programs. Incorporating Tedlar into MUTOH's marketing strategy provides powerful proof points: they can promote complete durability solutions (not just printers), educate customers on extending graphics lifespan with premium overlaminates, and create co-marketing opportunities with DuPont's 60+ year brand heritage. This enables stronger messaging around total cost of ownership, premium quality positioning, and thought leadership in outdoor/durable graphics applications. This role cares about brand perception, marketing campaign ROI, competitive differentiation, lead generation quality, and customer education effectiveness—all enhanced by association with industry-leading Tedlar protective films.
